description: How long the Department of Home Affairs is taking to decide applications for an Australian visa subclass: the days within which 25%, 50%, 75% and 90% of recent applications were decided, optionally for one nationality (split by applying from inside or outside Australia).

country.description: Two-letter nationality code (ISO 3166-1), e.g. "IN", for that nationality's times.

stream.description: Stream id, for subclasses with streams (e.g. "29" for the 600 tourist stream applying from outside Australia). Omit for the main stream; if that has no data, the error lists the streams that do, with their names.

name: get_processing_times
title: Australian visa processing times
